title: A paid booking follows the same slot rules as a free one, sends a confirmation and a reminder, and a failed checkout frees its slot

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21 in code (dark until deposits are live, and on the LIVE-234 money-proof path). holdSlotForBooking calls slotLengthAt(windows, startsAt, now) with no options: it ignores the service's duration (ends_at uses the window's slot_minutes), buffers, minimum notice, days off and override hours, calendar blocks, the schedule's zone, the service-to-window binding, overlap with other bookings, and any booking window past 14 days (a paid booking 15+ days out is refused). It also drops the note, answers and service_type_id. On settle, confirmBookingByOrder only flips status: no booking confirmation, no .ics, no reminder, no timeline entry. The Market door (app/(main)/(marketplace)/market/service-actions.ts) releases a failed hold with cancelBooking, which returns ok() for any non-confirmed row, so the pending hold keeps the slot for good (startServiceDeposit already uses releasePendingHold for exactly this reason). Fix: place the hold through validateAndPlaceBooking with a paid-hold mode, call afterBookingPlaced on settle, and use releasePendingHold on the Market door.

DONE 2026-11-21: holdSlotForBooking now places the hold through validateAndPlaceBooking in a paid-hold mode (status pending, product_id on the base row, no guest token, note, answers and service_type_id kept, month meter checked once in the core), so service duration, buffers, minimum notice, days off and override hours, calendar blocks, the schedule zone, the service-to-window binding, overlap with other bookings and the full booking window all apply. startServiceDeposit passes its service type (and optional note and answers, also on the booking-actions wrapper); the Market door passes only the product, and the active service type selling it is resolved, else the window grid is used under the same schedule rules. It returns the reason on a miss instead of null. confirmBookingByOrder reads the order's pending holds before the flip and, after it, announces only those now confirmed through afterBookingPlaced (notifyBookingConfirmed with the .ics, the reminder, the member timeline), best-effort, so a retried settle sends nothing twice; strict semantics are unchanged. The Market door releases a failed checkout's hold with the now-exported releasePendingHold, also when checkout throws. Tests: lib/spaces/booking.test.ts (a paid hold uses the free booking rules and is announced on settle) and app/(main)/(marketplace)/market/service-actions.test.ts (a failed checkout frees the hold). Follow-on: components/spaces/booking-picker.tsx should pass note and answers to startServiceDeposit, or a paid service with a required question is refused.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
